newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: Facing a very large add need, the Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements on Wednesday.
Analysts said the RP should be about $6 billion for the final day of the Fed's two-week maintenance period.
"The (Fed's) open market desk is behind on its add need; they were skimpy in adding reserves this week," said Kathy Bostjancic, money market analyst at UBS Securities LLC.

For that and other technical reasons federal funds have come under pressure. Funds opened at 5-3/4 percent and at 0930 EST/1430 GMT were at 5-11/16 -- above the 5-1/2 percent targer rate, which was raised by 1/4-point by the Fed on Tuesday.

Analysts noted that the upcoming quarter-end, the end of the Japanese fiscal year, the settlements of the Treasury's two- and five-year notes and the Easter holiday weekend are putting pressure on funds.
The large need for reserves could prompt the Fed to add permanent reserves to the system as early as this session.
